scope: Personal site only; existing page layout, business manuscripts, privacy notice and form preserved.
format: Static HTML/CSS and original SVG shapes; no source runtime, iframe, tracking or remote fonts.
adaptations: EN/PT/ES native text with escaped substitutions
Technical design annotations and demonstration footers removed
Native source headlines retained as h4 within site sections
Figure numbers follow existing site order
Scoped styles and container queries prevent host style leakage
Narrow flywheel uses the same pills in sequence with copied arrowheads
Alternating Five Moats stone fills retained explicitly in CSS
Decorative SVGs and source glyph icons hidden from assistive technology
Fonts locally hosted with SIL Open Font License files
